🎪 2nd Annual · Pearl Street Brewing Co.
Step Right Up. It Is Going To Be One Wild Night
Three live bands, a DJ, and the whole brewery under the big top.
📍 Pearl Street Brewing Co.  ·  76 Pearl Street, Buffalo, NY
🎃 Under the Big Top
Spooky circus snacks and treats
Step right up. It is going to be One Wild Night.

This Halloween, Pearl Street Brewing Co. is once again transforming into a massively spooky night of live music, costumes, cocktails, prizes and surprises under the big top. It is the 2nd Annual Halloween Party, and it lands on the Friday before Halloween.
Doors and music run from 7:00 PM to 1:00 AM on Friday, October 30. Tickets are $25, and this is a 21+ night, so bring valid ID.
